description: A shell script for performing HTTP endpoint checks on core BankApp endpoints, including health checks, API documentation verification, Swagger UI accessibility, and H2 console availability.

methods.name: log_pass
methods.description: Logs a passing check and increments the PASS counter.

methods.name: log_fail
methods.description: Logs a failing check and increments the FAIL counter.

methods.name: log_skip
methods.description: Logs a skipped check and increments the SKIP counter.

methods.name: do_request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request using curl, capturing status code and response body.

methods.name: check_healthz
methods.description: Checks the /healthz endpoint for a 200 response and 'ok' status in JSON.

methods.name: check_actuator_health
methods.description: Checks the /actuator/health endpoint for a 200 response and 'up' status.

methods.name: check_openapi_docs
methods.description: Verifies the presence of 'openapi' or 'swagger' in the /v3/api-docs response.

methods.name: check_swagger_ui
methods.description: Checks accessibility of Swagger UI at /swagger-ui.html.

methods.name: check_h2_console
methods.description: Checks accessibility of H2 console at /h2-console.
